$comment: The second iteration of an agent loop. This is the shape DEF-01 made inexpressible: the assistant's TOOL_CALL turn is present in history, followed by the TOOL_RESULT correlated to it by toolCallId. Note that the tool result is carried as ordinary content — the gateway advertised the tool and normalised the call, but the tool layer decided and executed it (ADR-0010 §2).
